text: 3.2 1. The hotel sounded wonderful. The terminal was so crowded. 2. There was only a theme park. There were queues everywhere. 3. We had booked a taxi. I was in such a bad mood. 4. There was a train strike that day. It was quieter in the autumn. 5. My neighbour offered to take us. I was so relieved to get home. 6. The bus service was terrible. The journey was a nightmare.
